video_title: A Day Inside An NBA Training Facility

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on the adjustment to NBA-standard basketballs
quotes.excerpt: If you've never felt an NBA basketball before, it does not feel like a normal Wilson
quotes.quote: If you've never felt an NBA basketball before, it does not feel like a normal Wilson or whatever you use in high school and everything. A lot of people that don't play in the NBA don't necessarily love them. Once you're in the NBA and that's all you use, you become accustomed to it.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on the comprehensive support available to Timberwolves players
quotes.excerpt: Anything you need to get better, they have here
quotes.quote: Anything you need to get better, they have here. From managers to rebound, to people to watch film with, to people to help you recover, to stuff you need to recover, dietitians, weight coaches. There is no reason you should fail at this level because you didn't have everything. Everything you have is really in-house.
